data.one_liner: An MCP server enabling AI assistants to control and monitor Patrol tests in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Patrol MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that empowers AI assistants to run, monitor, and manage interactive Patrol development sessions in Flutter projects. It provides tools to execute tests, stream logs, capture screenshots, and read native UI trees.
use_when: You want AI assistants like Claude or Cursor to run and manage your Patrol tests.
You need automated screenshot capture and native UI tree inspection during AI-driven test sessions.
avoid_when: You are not using Patrol for your Flutter integration tests.
Your workflow does not use AI assistants supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP).
strengths: Enables AI agents to directly run, monitor, and debug Patrol integration tests.
Supports multi-device management and automatic device selection.
Cleans up sessions automatically to prevent orphaned processes.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Patrol testing ecosystem and MCP-compatible editors.
Requires specific setup of MCP configuration in your development environment.
data.setup_notes: Add patrol_mcp as a dev dependency, then configure your editor's MCP server settings (e.g., in .mcp.json) with `dart run patrol_mcp`.
